newsitem.title: UK: European Dairy for Advertising & Media to July 20.
newsitem.headline: European Dairy for Advertising & Media to July 20.

text.p: REUTERS EUROPEAN DIARY OF EVENTS FOR ADVERTISING & MEDIA - to
The following is a four-week diary of events covering advertising, marketing, media and the Internet in Europe.
TUESDAY, JUNE 24
CANNES - International Advertising Festival. Screenings of advertisements, 9 a.m. to 7 p.m. Press and Poster Awards
Ceremony, 8 p.m. (six-day festival, June 23-28)
LONDON - Total Publishing, Business Design Centre, Islington,
London. Contact: (44) 181 390 0203. (first day of two-day
conference).
LONDON - The Power of the Brand, seminar on changing role of the
brand. The Clifton Ford, 47 Wellbeck Street, W1M 8BH. Contact:
(44) 171 824 8257. (two-day seminar, June 24-25).
LONDON - Internet '97, conference and seminars. An Internet
event for small- and medium-sized businesses. How to take
advantage of the Internet, sell products and services on the
Net, exploit the Net to boost advertising, use the Net to work
smarter, and how to profit from the Net even if you don't have
your own Web site. Earl's Court Paragon Hotel, London. Contact:
confdesk@firstconf.com. Web Site at http://www.firstconf.com
(three-day conference and exhibition, June 23 to 25)

MONDAY, JUNE 30
LUXEMBOURG - EU culture ministers meet. Provisional agenda
includes amendments to the "television without frontiers"
directive on cross-border broadcasting, proposed fund for EU
audiovisual producers, cooperation between public broadcast
corporations, decision on European Cultural Cities.
